from.place: ## Proof, step (b) Essential surjectivity: algebraization through formal glueing, specifically the torsion-extension descent used in Proposition 05ER

title: Extension descent assembles from summands of the quotient
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a flat map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $N$ an $R$-module and $(C_j)_{j\in J}$ any family of $R$-modules. Put $P=\bigoplus_{j\in J}C_j$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules]. Assume that for each $j$ every $S$-module extension $0\to N\otimes_RS\to T_j\to C_j\otimes_RS\to0$ is isomorphic, with its end terms fixed, to the base change of an $R$-module extension $0\to N\to E_j\to C_j\to0$. Then every $S$-module extension $0\to N\otimes_RS\to T\to P\otimes_RS\to0$ is likewise isomorphic, with its end terms fixed, to the base change of an $R$-module extension $0\to N\to E\to P\to0$ [def-weil-module-base-change], [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. The family $J$ need not be finite.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma 05EG (lemma-neighbourhood-extensions, line 24516): 'Using compatibility of Ext with direct sums (details omitted) we reduce to the case where M = R/I^n'

proof.text: For each $j$, let $T_j=T\mathbin{\times_{P\otimes_RS}}(C_j\otimes_RS)$ be the pullback of the given $S$-extension $0\to N\otimes_RS\to T\to P\otimes_RS\to0$ along $\iota_j\otimes_RS$. Thus $T_j$ is an $S$-extension of $C_j\otimes_RS$ by $N\otimes_RS$. By the hypothesis, choose an $R$-extension $0\to N\to E_j\to C_j\to0$ and a fixed-end-term equivalence $[T_j]=[E_j\otimes_RS]$. Applying the surjectivity of $\Phi_R$ from [lem-weil-pbc-ext-one-direct-sum] gives an $R$-extension $0\to N\to E\to P\to0$ whose pullback along every $\iota_j$ has class $[E_j]$. An equivalence of $R$-extensions base-changes to an equivalence of $S$-extensions, since [def-weil-module-base-change] sends identities to identities and preserves composition.

First, [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-commutes-with-colimits] identifies $P\otimes_RS$ with $\bigoplus_{j\in J}(C_j\otimes_RS)$ and carries each $\iota_j\otimes_RS$ to the canonical inclusion. Tensoring $0\to N\to E\to P\to0$ with the flat module $S$ gives a short exact sequence $0\to N\otimes_RS\to E\otimes_RS\to P\otimes_RS\to0$ by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact] and [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-right-exact]. For each $j$, $(E\mathbin{\times_P}C_j)\otimes_RS\cong(E\otimes_RS)\mathbin{\times_{P\otimes_RS}}(C_j\otimes_RS)$: the left fibre product is the kernel of $E\oplus C_j\to P$, tensor commutes with this finite direct sum, and [lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact] preserves the kernel. Hence the pullback tuple of $[E\otimes_RS]$ under $\Phi_S$ is $([E_j\otimes_RS])_j=([T_j])_j$, which is the pullback tuple of $[T]$. The injectivity of [lem-weil-pbc-ext-one-direct-sum] for $A=S$ gives $[E\otimes_RS]=[T]$, i.e. a fixed-end-term equivalence. The base-change equivalences used here are compatible with identities and composition by [def-weil-module-base-change].

lean.statement: theorem extension_descends_of_summands {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (_hflat : (algebraMap R S).Flat) {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {J : Type x} (C : J → Type y) [∀ j, AddCommGroup (C j)] [∀ j, Module R (C j)] (_hC : ∀ (j : J) (T : Type z) [AddCommGroup T] [Module S T] (a : S ⊗[R] N →ₗ[S] T) (b : T →ₗ[S] S ⊗[R] C j), Function.Injective a → Function.Exact a b → Function.Surjective b → ∃ (E : Type (max w y)) (_ : AddCommGroup E) (_ : Module R E) (i : N →ₗ[R] E) (q : E →ₗ[R] C j), Function.Injective i ∧ Function.Exact i q ∧ Function.Surjective q ∧ ∃ θ : S ⊗[R] E ≃ₗ[S] T, θ.toLinearMap.comp (i.baseChange S) = a ∧ b.comp θ.toLinearMap = q.baseChange S) {T : Type z} [AddCommGroup T] [Module S T] (a : S ⊗[R] N →ₗ[S] T) (b : T →ₗ[S] S ⊗[R] (⨁ j, C j)) (_ha : Function.Injective a) (_hab : Function.Exact a b) (_hb : Function.Surjective b) : ∃ (E : Type (max w x y)) (_ : AddCommGroup E) (_ : Module R E) (i : N →ₗ[R] E) (q : E →ₗ[R] (⨁ j, C j)), Function.Injective i ∧ Function.Exact i q ∧ Function.Surjective q ∧ ∃ θ : S ⊗[R] E ≃ₗ[S] T, θ.toLinearMap.comp (i.baseChange S) = a ∧ b.comp θ.toLinearMap = q.baseChange S
